text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What a sweet daydream...! Did the Three 
Goddesses disguise themselves as deities 
of dreams and descend before me?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This mighty power can no longer be 
contained! That's right! I am the God of 
Destruction!!
